name: GeneralAllocator::Construct
notes: Hooked. 60 runs x 400 random operations (malloc/free/realloc incl. sizes at each realloc, large-block and trim boundary, SetOption, TrimCore, MallocConsolidate, AddCore, out-of-memory callback and growth-failure runs, then Shutdown and re-init), original and ours on separate redirected VirtualAlloc arenas; allocator state and every committed page compared after each step. Mutation check: 13 mutants, 10 killed; equivalent: word-copy vs memcpy threshold, the +0x478 save/clear (nothing in the allocator reads it); untestable: ExtendCore's failed-commit path (the original faults right after on the uncommitted page).

name: GeneralAllocator::DefaultAssert
notes: Default assert callback: DebugString(text) then a debugger break. Hooked (17 bytes). Not byte-matched (build profile differs) and not difftestable (it breaks into the debugger). Lane QN: owned so the image-free build needs no game code for the allocator default.
